---
title: Blanket pattern template
description: Reusable Markdown template for writing and sharing knit or crochet blanket patterns with sections for sizing, gauge, materials, stitch pattern repeats, and step-by-step directions
---

Use this reusable template to write and share your knit or crochet blanket patterns in Markdown. Fill in the bracketed sections with your pattern details. This template works for any blanket size from lovey to king, including modular and center-out constructions.

**Related guides:** [Blanket measurement guide](/reference/blanket-measurement/)

### Color or Motif Layout

For modular blankets, arrange pieces according to the layout below. Reading order is left to right, top to bottom.

| Row | Col 1 | Col 2 | Col 3 | Col 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [color/motif] | [color/motif] | [color/motif] | [color/motif] |

**[N] squares across x [N] squares tall = [N] total motifs.**
